summary: A per-crate rust-tests note counts only when its run ran a test, unless the accepted base lists the crate under no_tests in .st/rust-test-inputs.json; the keys come only from the accepted base's rust-test-keys and inputs once a policy judges rust-tests

replay.detail: CI and local tooling only; no product code changes.

compatibility.detail: No product contract change. The rust-tests policy entry is not enforced and no gate job reads it yet.
